description: Lower port: a driver declares the capabilities it has; the core returns unsupported for any operation that needs a missing one. Driver errors (timeout, unreadable output) are unknown, never closed or gone.

capabilities.name: tab.create
capabilities.meaning: open a new tab whose first pane is the new slot

capabilities.name: pane.split
capabilities.meaning: split a live pane in a direction with a ratio

capabilities.name: pane.run
capabilities.meaning: run a command line in a pane's shell

capabilities.name: send.text
capabilities.meaning: type literal text into a pane

capabilities.name: send.keys
capabilities.meaning: send key presses to a pane

capabilities.name: process.info
capabilities.meaning: foreground process group and processes of a pane

capabilities.name: activity.state
capabilities.meaning: agent lifecycle state of the pane (idle, working, blocked, done)

capabilities.name: label
capabilities.meaning: set display labels of a tab or pane

capabilities.name: layout.geometry
capabilities.meaning: real rect of the tab area and of every pane in it

capabilities.name: server.incarnation
capabilities.meaning: identity of the multiplexer server process: peer credentials of its socket, then start time and boot id of that pid

notes: absent means the herdr binary is not found (ENOENT): every operation is unsupported, direct mode is unaffected
windows: herdr ships no Windows build today (herdr-plugin.toml declares linux and macos); the driver declares nothing until it does

tmux.status: deferred; the port has room for it

closeRule: pane.close requires server.incarnation: the driver reads the incarnation right before and right after the close; a mismatch or an unreadable incarnation makes the result unknown and the pane is never closed a second time
